region: Southern United States and tropical Americas
habitat: Woodland edges, shrubby thickets and gardens
season: Year-round in much of Florida and the tropics
identification: Long, narrow black wings crossed by pale yellow bands.
fact: Adults may gather in small communal roosts at night.
form: Representative form; individual colors and markings vary
